title: The Quiet Echo
author: Juniper Iversen
blurb: Zephyrine Iversen, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the fleet's truce expires.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
